sections.label: Overview
blocks: The map covers **18,355 works** and **39,312 authors**, grown by 2-hop citation expansion from **245 resolved Cifra seed works**. Bibliographic-coupling community detection (Leiden) separates the field into distinct intellectual sub-fields; the sonoluminescence/cavitation physics forms its **own** communities, confirming empirically that it is an adjacency to, not part of, the biophoton core.
Field-wide openness: **38%** of works are open access; **7301** have a preprint; **29** carry an open-data/code signal in their abstract.

blocks.lead: Inside the biophoton core: sub-strands (Leiden res 3.0).

blocks: Re-clustering community 0 resolves the true UPE core into distinct research strands (the biofield/EEG/EMF/quantum-information literature splits off into its own sub-clusters):

items: **human UPE & measurement methodology** (sub 1: 335 works, 44 seeds): Roeland Van Wijk, Michal Cifra, Eduard P.A. Van Wijk, Eduard van Wijk. e.g. Ultra-weak photon emission from biological samples: Definition, mechanisms, prop (2014.0, 269c)

**cellular communication through light** (sub 9: 205 works, 14 seeds): Max Myakishev-Rempel, Ilya Volodyaev, Ivan Savelev, Daniel Fels. e.g. Eukaryotic Cells and their Cell Bodies: Cell Theory Revised (2004.0, 146c)

**delayed luminescence & photosynthesis** (sub 4: 247 works, 12 seeds): Agata Scordino, Francesco Musumeci, Rosaria Grasso, M. Gulino. e.g. Monitoring and screening plant populations with combined thermal and chlorophyll (2006.0, 241c)

**biophoton imaging & plant/animal UPE** (sub 2: 288 works, 7 seeds): Cristiano M. Gallep, Setsuko Komatsu, Kimihiko Kato, Hiroyuki Iyozumi. e.g. In vivo imaging of spontaneous ultraweak photon emission from a rat’s brain corr (1999.0, 188c)

**ROS / singlet-oxygen photon emission** (sub 0: 474 works, 7 seeds): Roeland Van Wijk, Eduard P.A. Van Wijk, Paul S. Francis, Neil W. Barnett. e.g. Singlet Molecular Oxygen Reactions with Nucleic Acids, Lipids, and Proteins (2019.0, 638c)

**neural / brain optical signalling** (sub 15: 155 works, 6 seeds): Jiapei Dai, Christoph Simon, Zhuo Wang, Vahid Salari. e.g. Optical windows for head tissues in near‐infrared and short‐wave infrared region (2018.0, 204c)
**coherence theory (Popp school)** (sub 19: 114 works, 5 seeds): Fritz-Albert Popp, F. A. Popp, L. V. Beloussov, Jiin-Ju Chang. e.g. Energy Flow in Proteins (2008.0, 316c)

**water & coherent domains** (sub 5: 241 works, 5 seeds): Pierre Madl, Larissa Brizhik, В.Л. Воейков, Alberto Tedeschi. e.g. Water Dynamics at the Root of Metamorphosis in Living Organisms (2010.0, 160c)

**retinal & brain single-photon signalling** (sub 18: 116 works, 3 seeds): István Bókkon, Vahid Salari, Jack A. Tuszyński, Jiapei Dai. e.g. Single-photon detection by rod cells of the retina (1998.0, 271c)

blocks: **Split-off, consciousness/paranormal wing** (sub 8: 214 works, 9 seeds): Michael A. Persinger, Blake T. Dotta, Nirosha J. Murugan, Lukasz M. Karbowski. This is the reputationally-mixed strand the book should handle separately; researchers here are flagged consciousness_adjacent=1 in researchers.csv.

sections.label: The open-vs-closed analysis
blocks: Within the biophoton core (community 0, researchers with ≥3 in-universe works), the openness overlay separates who builds the field in the open from who encloses it:

items: **Author disambiguation:** OpenAlex splits some core authors (Van Wijk, Popp merged here; others flagged in author_splits_flagged.json): a manual pass would sharpen centrality/ranking.
**Full-text open-data signals:** open-data/code detection here is abstract-level; scanning OA full text would raise recall.
**The consciousness-adjacent wing** (Persinger, Dotta, Tuszyński in community 0) is reputationally mixed and worth separating editorially in the book.
